name: Battleworn Axe
summary: In Redridge, Battleworn Axe blades show where Blackrock orcs are invading the mountains. Marshal Marris takes the recovered weapons in Lakeshire as proof of the danger to its people.

sections.title: Trophy of an Invader
sections.body: Blackrock reavers carry heavy, nicked axes as they push south from the Burning Steppes into Redridge. Marshal Marris and Lakeshire's hard-pressed town watch gather the blades. Each one confirms another marauding orc has fallen and shows how well armed the warband is.

sections.title: The Threat in the Hills
sections.body: Blackrock invaders have fortified Stonewatch Keep and seized footholds in southeastern Redridge. Their advance has trapped townspeople in Lakeshire. Taking the battleworn weapons leaves fewer arms to the warband and clears roads for Alliance travel.

faq.answer: Blackrock orcs in the Redridge Mountains carry Battleworn Axes, rugged weapons worn by hard use. Recovered blades prove that invaders have been slain.

faq.q: Who wants these axes in Lakeshire?
faq.answer: Marshal Marris commands Lakeshire's town guard and wants the axes as proof that the Blackrock threat is being pushed back from town lands.

faq.q: Where do these axes come from?
faq.answer: Blackrock orcs carry these axes throughout Redridge, especially near Stonewatch Keep to the north and in orc encampments to the southeast.

faq.q: Why are the orcs in Redridge in the first place?
aliases: why are blackrock orcs in redridge
faq.answer: The Blackrock clan marched south through the mountain passes from the Burning Steppes and captured Stonewatch Keep. The clan then marauded across northern and eastern Redridge to pin down Lakeshire.

angles.text: For the Alliance, each axe brought to Lakeshire marks one fewer invader threatening Redridge's exposed citizens. Stormwind's core forces are elsewhere.
As a blacksmith, you can see the resilient, heavy forging typical of Blackrock weapons in these crude iron blades, despite their jagged edges and chips.
